method:
Read-only audit; nothing written in the repo. All work ran against byte copies in /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-Cartalith-GDT/9bb82d91-f6d5-50c4-b743-a54d60b8e9ff/scratchpad/audit-visual/:
- v272.html comes from `git show 7bd3b49:"html/Cartalith v2.72 DCC test.html"`. Its md5 57e6628a… matches the working file.
- v271.html is copied from reference/.

Harness: Playwright, headless Chromium 153, DPR 1. Scripts are lib.js and capA–capK.js in that folder.

How worlds were made, with real clicks wherever a user would click:
- Generation went through the start card: Generate a world → seed field → Generate world.
  - Seed 12345 at the card's default 2K (37.8–39.4 s), in dark and in light.
  - Seed 4242 at 2K.
  - 1K worlds for the targeted probes.
- Populated with CIVIL ▸ Generation ▸ Auto-populate.
- Recorded years 380 and 412 through the strip's own year field and Add year.
- Places selected by mouse clicks at `_civPlaceScreenPos`.

What was captured:
- Sizes:
  - Dark, both seeds: 1366×768, 1600×900, 1920×1080, 2560×1440.
  - Light: 1600×900, plus the other three sizes on seed 12345.
- Every menu and submenu.
- Every modal or window, opened through its real entry:
  - start card and New World;
  - Settings (5 pages), Credits, Generation info;
  - Find, map context menu, Base map popover;
  - city viewer;
  - route editor (route drawn with the Route tool, then Commit route, then Edit route…);
  - Settlements screen (4 tabs);
  - Asset Library and slicer;
  - the loading screen;
  - the finalized state, after a real Bake & finalize.
- Dock scroll series for:
  - WORLD Generate and Sculpt;
  - CIVIL ×5 sub-pages;
  - CARTO;
  - EXPLORE.
- Hover crops and keyboard-focus crops.
- Phone at 412×915 (touch) for the shared modals.

Design side:
- Desktop.dc.html at its four size chips and its theme switch.
- Clicks inside the frame: File, Export, Preferences, timeline expanded, CIVIL, a selection, Sculpt.
- Computed styles of 32 design controls in the 1366 frame, which is shown at 100 % (data/d_styles_1366.json).

In-page measurements:
- WCAG contrast of every visible text node against its composited background, with ancestor opacity applied (data/*contrast*.json).
- Truncation (scrollWidth > clientWidth).
- Off-window controls.
- A control-style census (data/*controls*.json) and an emoji census.
- Token pairs computed in Python (data/token_contrast.txt).

Testing the fixes:
- Each proposed CSS fix was injected into a scratch page with addStyleTag, then re-captured and re-measured.
- All fixes together are /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-Cartalith-GDT/9bb82d91-f6d5-50c4-b743-a54d60b8e9ff/scratchpad/audit-visual/fixes.css. Re-measured in dark and light: data/j_after.json, k_sculpt.json.
- New versus pre-existing: v2.71 and v2.72 compared on the same boot world (Skip for now), by computed style (data/g_v271_vs_v272.json).

Checks on the evidence itself:
- Every screenshot cited was opened and looked at. Crops at 2–3× are under sheets/.
- Page errors: none in any run (pageerror and console-error listeners). The only dialogs were my own reload's beforeunload and the Bake confirm.

Checked and found sound: the eight menus and their rows, the Help readout, Find's results, the 860 px slot moves, the finalized-state dimming, and hover states (all visible).

Path convention: every path below is under /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-Cartalith-GDT/9bb82d91-f6d5-50c4-b743-a54d60b8e9ff/scratchpad/audit-visual/.

findings.title: [CHEAP+HIGH] CIVIL ▸ Settlements table rows run together into one string
findings.evidence:
In a 1600×900 capture every row reads like 'AbedomarmarchCapitalKorrath19,30661%Trade hub5Fortified' and is clipped at the right. Files: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-Cartalith-GDT/9bb82d91-f6d5-50c4-b743-a54d60b8e9ff/scratchpad/audit-visual/shots/b_64_dock_civ_settlements_s0.png and the 2× crop /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-Cartalith-GDT/9bb82d91-f6d5-50c4-b743-a54d60b8e9ff/scratchpad/audit-visual/sheets/settle_table.png.

Measured (data/e_measures.json, E1): computed display is 'block' on 3 of 3 sampled visible rows, and their inline style has no display.

Cause: `_stEnsurePool` writes `display:flex` into each row's style.cssText. `_stUpdateVisible` then sets `row.style.display=''`, which deletes that declaration.

Pre-existing, not new in v2.72: `grep -n "row.style.display=''; row.style.transform"` finds v271.html:21734 and v272.html:22816. The same line is in the RC clone's v1.16 onward.

Before/after with the fix injected: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-Cartalith-GDT/9bb82d91-f6d5-50c4-b743-a54d60b8e9ff/scratchpad/audit-visual/shots/e_E1_table_before.png and /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-Cartalith-GDT/9bb82d91-f6d5-50c4-b743-a54d60b8e9ff/scratchpad/audit-visual/shots/e_E1_table_after.png. The pair is also in /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-Cartalith-GDT/9bb82d91-f6d5-50c4-b743-a54d60b8e9ff/scratchpad/audit-visual/sheets/before_after_1.png.
findings.proposal:
Add one CSS rule beside the #stViewport rules: `#stSpacer > div{display:flex}`.

Pool rows that are hidden keep their inline `display:none`, which still wins, so the JS needs no change. The equivalent JS fix is in `_stUpdateVisible`: `row.style.display='flex'`.

Optional: after the fix, names ellipsize in the 372–400 px dock (62–72 px of 107 px at 1366 and 1920, data/j_after.json). Giving Name room, for example by hiding Econ. role in the dock, is a separate choice.
findings.risk: None to behaviour: hide and show still go through the inline display. Re-check that the header row (#stTableHead) still lines up with the data columns; it does in e_E1_table_after.png.

Visible in:
- CIVIL's GENERATION tab: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-Cartalith-GDT/9bb82d91-f6d5-50c4-b743-a54d60b8e9ff/scratchpad/audit-visual/shots/b_11_place_selected_1600.png.

Cause: the v2.23 theme layer's `button.on{background:var(--accent);border:1px solid var(--accent);font-weight:600}`, specificity (0,1,1).

- It out-specifies `.subtab` (0,1,0).
- Each `.on` rule then recolours only one side, so the other three sides keep the 1px accent border.

The theme layer's own rule 3 says 'an active surface is a wash plus an edge'.

Pre-existing: v2.71 measures the same (data/g_v271_vs_v272.json).

Before/after: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-Cartalith-GDT/9bb82d91-f6d5-50c4-b743-a54d60b8e9ff/scratchpad/audit-visual/shots/e_D2_setnav_before.png and /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-Cartalith-GDT/9bb82d91-f6d5-50c4-b743-a54d60b8e9ff/scratchpad/audit-visual/shots/e_D2_setnav_after.png.
findings.proposal:
Add after the theme layer's `button.on` rule:
`.subtab.on{border:0;border-bottom:2px solid var(--accent);font-weight:inherit}`
`.set-nav button.on{border:0;border-left:2px solid var(--accent);font-weight:inherit}`
`@media (max-width:860px){ .set-nav button.on{border-left:0;border-bottom:2px solid var(--accent)} }`
findings.risk: Font-weight 600 goes away on these active labels. The underline or bar, the wash and the accent colour still mark the state.

findings.title: [OWNER, LOW] Type faces and status-bar density differ from the design
findings.evidence:
The design loads IBM Plex Mono and uses Helvetica Neue (Desktop.dc.html helmet).

The file's stacks resolve differently by platform:
- here: DejaVu Sans Mono and Inter;
- on Windows: Consolas or Cascadia and Segoe UI.
At .2em tracking the mono widths vary by about 9 %, which moves every truncation point (V14, V18).

The design's status bar holds 3 items. v2.72's holds about 15 chips of generation statistics: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-Cartalith-GDT/9bb82d91-f6d5-50c4-b743-a54d60b8e9ff/scratchpad/audit-visual/sheets/statusbar_1600.png.
findings.proposal: Either embed one mono face (a Plex Mono subset as a base64 @font-face, about 30–60 KB), so widths are the same on every OS, or keep the system stacks and the wrap-to-hide rules (V14). Moving the physics chips into Generation info is the owner's call.
findings.risk: An embedded font adds file size, and the licence must be confirmed (Plex is OFL).

limits:
- Fonts. This machine has no Consolas, Cascadia, SF Mono or Segoe UI: --mono resolved to DejaVu Sans Mono and --sans to Inter. Width-dependent numbers (V14's 78 px, V18's 16 px) may differ on the owner's Windows machine. The proposed fixes hold either way.
- Browser. Headless Chromium only; Firefox and Safari were not run. Native select popups, number spinners and date pickers cannot be captured headless, so V02 needs one look by hand. WebGL 3D was not examined (the software path runs headless).
- Contrast over the map (legend, scale bar) is computed for two grounds only, white snow and sand #d9c79c, not sampled per pixel.
- Not covered: screen readers; touch targets on desktop; the phone shell itself (stage 2 owns it). Only the shared modals were checked at 412×915.
- Concurrency. Ran while the main loop ran its stage-2 probes (load 1.5–2.2). Captures are visual, not timings.
- Out of scope, seen in passing: after generation, the map opens at 'cover' zoom (20 km scale bar at 2K) and the terrain looks soft at that zoom. That is map rendering, not the shell.
